propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend fails isinstance(Backend) because it is missing query_project and assert_env_ready, which must be implemented in backend.py without weakening any contract-suite assertion.
The reconciler.backend config validator only accepts {"jira"}, leaving the registered jira-datacenter backend unreachable via config until _as_choice is widened.
test_backend_contract.py's fixture must include jira-datacenter so the DC backend is held to every generic port assertion.

DC inbound assignees mint no ghost identity because the accountId guard returns early and DC users carry name/key with no accountId; fixing that guard alone then triggers a swallowed ValueError from mapping vendor 'jira-datacenter' to an invalid creation_channel, so both halves must land together mapping to the shared 'jira' channel without widening CREATION_CHANNELS.
The J2 import checker lacks the reciprocal rule forbidding adapters/jira_datacenter modules from importing adapters/jira, and the clean-core-wheel check omits 'jira'.

A live end-to-end reconcile pass against the J5 harness must converge, be idempotent on repeat, and assert zero unhandled exceptions by invoking the reconciler subprocess directly rather than via caplog.
